dashboard.limits: Tracks observed balance changes. Income and spending occurring between two checks may only be detected as a net change. Rent is not subtracted again.

dashboardKey.name: Open dashboard
dashboardKey.description: Key for the statistics dashboard during gameplay. Default: F8. Alternatively use /pixelstats dashboard. Does not intercept typing in chat or menus.

automaticRent.name: Detect rent automatically
automaticRent.description: Open your own apartment's rental menu and hover over the rent price to save the daily rent. A price set with /pixelstats rent takes priority.

netEarnings.name: Show net change
netEarnings.description: Subtract observed spending from income. Otherwise only positive balance changes count.

provisionalRewards.name: Show provisional chat credits
provisionalRewards.description: Show estimates marked ≈ while the Pixel scoreboard is missing. Only the scoreboard confirms income. Disable to display confirmed values only.

pixel_balance.name: Pixel balance
pixel_balance.description: Your confirmed Pixel balance. Optional chat estimates are marked ≈ while the Pixel scoreboard is missing.

commands.helpCommands: /pixelstats dashboard | status | debug | rent <Pixel per 3 days> | auto | resetincome <today|week|all>
commands.helpEarnings: The scoreboard confirms income. ≈ marks provisional chat credits. Provisional display and net mode are available in the addon settings.
commands.incomeResetUsage: /pixelstats resetincome <today|week|all> – clears income and net values for the selected period.
commands.incomeResetSuccess: Income and net values for the selected period reset. Balance, rent and apartment data are kept.
